summary: Linux process ownership at candidate 62b4106531, the head of lane/process-ownership-linux, which branched from develop bfce3d9249: seven lane commits from ec86035a26 to 68a0115065 (the exit drain built in ec86035a26 was removed in f5ea251bc3 under the lane brief's fixed decision 4, which the owner's D49 later accepted), then three review-fix commits, fd9c8242ba (PID-namespace inits are pinned before a SIGTERM too, and an adopted init is reaped as pid 1), aea2c8d7a6 (sandbox probes settle under the call's owner, bake_sandbox::ProbeOwner, with the session's WorkGate as the owner for bash, hook, and MCP server confinement), and 62b4106531 (config_value docs). The same attempt holds scope 04's Linux parts, which this lane changed in bake-sandbox: a bubblewrap payload's PID namespace killed and awaited, probes owned and settled, the write-only Linux contract for both runners in both modes, and strict BAKE_REQUIRE_SANDBOX_BACKENDS parsing. One record per attempt keeps them here, and no separate scope 04 record is written. Two full Linux preflights ran on this Fedora Linux 44 host, x86_64 only: at bd1562f911 (lane/integrate-03-05, this lane and the crash-matrix lane merged on bfce3d9249 with their docs), 39 gates passed with actionlint skipped, and the rust-test gate ran 3024 nextest cases, all passed with 8 skipped, plus the codemode harness's 98; at the 0.4 Linux integration head 3421fd94ce, 39 gates passed with actionlint skipped, and the rust-test gate ran 3092, all passed with 8 skipped, plus the 98. Each log names the commit and umask 022; the orchestrating session reports BAKE_REQUIRE_KERNEL_FAULTS=1 and BAKE_REQUIRE_SANDBOX_BACKENDS=bwrap,landlock and a clean tree, which the logs do not record. Under that sandbox variable the enforcement suite and pid_namespace fail instead of skipping when a named backend or user namespaces are missing. No rust/crates/bake-process or bake-sandbox file, and no fixture source below, differs between the candidate, bd1562f911, and 3421fd94ce. By D49, processes a bash command backgrounds on purpose outlive a normal shutdown and exit, as in Pi, and a config_value command's group is killed once its shell exits. The lane's controls and mutation runs left no logs. It does not supersede the 2026-10-19 native process owner or session work gate records, which cover the macOS owner and the WorkGate for file tools; it adds Linux ownership they leave open. Windows and macOS ownership, aarch64, and reviewer acceptance are missing.

results.behavior: bake-process's tests/pid_namespace.rs passed in both rust-test gates, 3 tests: a_killed_tree_ends_and_awaits_a_pid_namespace_outside_its_group, a_terminated_tree_still_ends_and_awaits_its_pid_namespace, and as_pid_1_an_adopted_init_is_reaped_once_reparented. The namespaces come from unshare, whose init has no --die-with-parent, so only the owner's own kill can end it in time: the init a tree member started, which leads its own session outside the group, is pinned by a pidfd, killed with the tree, and awaited, also after a SIGTERM ended its parent. The unit tests tree::linux::tests::namespace_inits_are_children_of_members_outside_the_group, nspid_marks_only_nested_inits, and as_pid_1_an_exited_init_is_released_only_once_reaped passed beside them (10 tree::linux tests in all). Counts describe nextest test cases.

bake-sandbox's tests/enforcement.rs passed in both gates, 37 cases, among them bwrap::a_killed_command_leaves_nothing_of_its_pid_namespace, which also runs bubblewrap without --die-with-parent so a missing wait is visible, and the case's SIGTERM before its kill. This is scope 04's no-surviving-owned-descendants proof for bubblewrap on Linux.

bwrap::linux_contract_confines_writes_only and landlock::linux_contract_confines_writes_only passed in both gates: under read-only and workspace-write a confined command reads outside its roots and opens a loopback TCP connection, and every write, overwrite, rename, delete, and directory creation outside the writable roots is denied, as 0.3's sandbox-local profiles allowed. harness::required_backends_are_read_from_the_environment passed: BAKE_REQUIRE_SANDBOX_BACKENDS accepts only bwrap and landlock, and a named backend that is missing fails instead of skipping. Scope 04's Linux part.

bake-sandbox's backends::tests::fake_runners passed in both gates (15 tests), including a_dropped_probe_is_settled_under_its_owners_claim and a_closing_owner_refuses_the_walk_and_caches_nothing: each runner probe holds a bake_process::Claim from its call's ProbeOwner until its tree is settled, and a closing owner refuses before any probe. bake-coding-agent's tests/sandbox_probe_shutdown.rs::shutdown_waits_for_a_probe_its_call_dropped passed: with this process a child subreaper, AgentSession::shutdown returns only once a dropped probe's process group is gone. tests/permissions.rs::a_bash_call_whose_owner_is_closing_is_aborted passed: the refused call reports Pi's aborted. Scope 04's probe ownership.

config_value::tests passed in both gates, 14 tests, among them a_background_holder_of_the_output_is_killed_at_completion, a_timed_out_command_and_its_holder_are_killed_and_reaped, a_cancelled_command_and_its_descendants_are_killed_and_reaped, an_escaped_holder_of_the_output_fails_the_command_at_the_timeout, and a_command_resolves_from_inside_a_runtime: a !command runs as an OwnedProcess group on a joined thread with a runtime of its own, killed and settled when its shell exits, at the timeout, on output overflow, and on cancel (D49 point 3). bake-process's tests/tied_leader.rs::a_tied_leader_dies_with_its_spawning_thread passed: a leader spawned with PR_SET_PDEATHSIG dies with its thread.

bake-tui's live::commands::gh::tests passed in both gates, 5 tests: esc_kills_the_gh_tree_and_waits_for_it, a_dropped_run_is_killed_and_awaited_by_shutdown, session_shutdown_waits_for_the_gh_tree, exits_and_failures_read_as_before, and only_the_gh_runner_inherits_the_whole_environment; with exec::tests::only_the_exec_module_names_inherit_all, they show gh for /share and /bug running through exec_command inside AgentSession::spawn_background, killed and awaited on Esc, a dropped run, and shutdown, checked through /proc, with ExecEnv::InheritAll pinned to exec and the gh runner.

tests/process_reap.rs passed in both gates, 12 tests, including a_normal_shutdown_leaves_an_intentionally_backgrounded_process_running, which pins D49 point 2: a process a bash command backgrounds on purpose outlives a normal session shutdown, as a finished command's descendants do in Pi, with no exit drain or subreaper; and shutdown_waits_for_a_cancelled_bash_call_group.
The new Linux ownership cases have Windows and macOS counterparts that run there: probe ownership through AppContainer and Seatbelt, and a host kill's effect on owned trees.

negativeControls.missing: The lane worker reports three controls on its uncommitted lane worktree before the review fixes: the old run_probe left a surviving sleep; without namespace adoption the bubblewrap run without --die-with-parent left 6 survivors; and without the cancel-on-drop guard the gh dropped-run test failed. It also reports bun run mutants:rust: tree.rs 39 caught, 16 missed, 0 timeouts; bake-sandbox's backends/mod.rs and bake-process's lib.rs 0 missed; and three missed config_value, gh, and exec mutants killed by new tests, each checked by hand. None saved output, an exit status, or a tree, and the review fixes fd9c8242ba and aea2c8d7a6 report no controls of their own.

missingEvidence.reason: The lane worker reports that the namespace-wait skips cannot be seen without a slowed namespace teardown, that the dedupe-key and prctl mutants are equivalent, and that the pid-1 waitid reap branch was untested; fd9c8242ba added as_pid_1 cases, but no mutation run after it is recorded.

missingEvidence.what: An init created and moved out of the group after the last look
missingEvidence.reason: A namespace init made just before its parent dies, after the kill's last walk of the group, is not awaited; no test covers it.
Only a leader tied to its thread with PR_SET_PDEATHSIG dies with the host; every other tree keeps running, and there is no durable cross-agent ownership tree or job reattachment after host death.

evalRecords.notApplicable: No model-visible change: the lane report and aea2c8d7a6 change no tool schema, description, result, error, prompt, context, or loop. A call refused because its owner is closing reports its existing cancellation (Pi's aborted for bash, the hook's cancelled text, a closed MCP server); gh output reaches the user only; config_value resolves keys and headers, and a !command whose background holds its output now resolves at once instead of at the timeout.

rollback.observed: Each test owns its temporary directories and the processes it starts. pid_namespace and the bubblewrap cases kill and await the namespaces they start; tied_leader forgets an owner on purpose and reaps that leader itself, in a test binary of its own; sandbox_probe_shutdown makes its own process a child subreaper, in a binary of its own, and reaps the probe's killed descendant; the gh tests use a fake gh and check /proc for the tree's end. No user home is touched. Each preflight log opens with its commit and umask 022; neither records git status, and the orchestrating session reports both trees clean. The fixture files above have the same bytes at the candidate, at bd1562f911, and at 3421fd94ce.

review.missing: No reviewer has accepted scope 05 or scope 04. The orchestrating session's review agents reviewed the lane and a fix worker fixed their findings in fd9c8242ba, aea2c8d7a6, and 62b4106531; that is not scope acceptance.
